title: Default test run at nmskpkrkukuy
description: The default test run (python3 lib/tools/test_costs.py run: cargo test and every Python suite, the unit and tool tiers) at change nmskpkrkukuy, "The default run builds Rust's tests in a lightly optimised profile and takes 3.4 minutes: the engine's own tests are sev", queued with Rust's tests in the test-fast profile: the run's time as a job, and the profile's first build in the job's warm target directory. Nobody waits for it: the watcher or the next session reads the result, and sync.py push requires a passed run that covers the commit it pushes (verification/default_tests.py).
expected: exits 0: every test of the default run passes

resources.notes: as a job on six CPUs the run took 19.5 minutes one test file after another, 14.5 with Rust beside Python and 8.6 with the Rust binaries and Python files several at a time (2026-11-17), longer beside proof jobs; its cargo target directory is kept warm between runs
